text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, B, D and E after modest gains may have reduced my participation in later upside; I should use clear target weights and a plan rather than sell simply because a position is up.","I sold Stock C at a steep loss, then bought it back at a higher price; before changing course, I should reassess its prospects and risk instead of reacting to losses or recent prices.","My account moved both up and down while I often made no trades; I should review holdings and cash periodically against my goals, while avoiding unnecessary month-to-month reactions."]}
